status: Frozen local development specification before executing this application; not an external preregistration or untouched final evaluation
purpose: Advance the source-backed internally used reconstruction-to-query-to-actual-return requirement, keeping a persistent receiving surrogate and frozen-versus-relearned intervention roles explicit.
sourceRole: Reuse only its declared ERG-shaped linear input matrix, not native transduction, an anatomical Dm9 fit or its prior artificial metamer stimuli.
receiverBoundary: Two persistent virtual receiving banks, each pooling the four type coordinates and one Dm9-like state. Direct paired inhibition, distinct inhibitory/excitatory inputs and positive output have source-motivated signs. All magnitudes, pooling, baseline, discretization and time are engineered. Linear rate deviations are not membrane voltage, Twitch calcium, an oscillator or a full PWD/NAPOT implementation.
learningBoundary: Supervised public familiarization acquires four cross-view prototypes and a linear state-conditioned sensory readout. The labels specify the learned action-relevant key, not the identity or location of a running-world object. No test-world state enters training. The direct comparator is offered the same calibration and teaching records.
observationConventions: Raw decoded values are saved; negative decoded coordinates are clipped only for normalized feature matching. An absent retinal-bin sample supplies zero drive but cannot update object identity. Both are engineered conventions, not claims about signed calcium, missing recordings or native darkness. Retinal addresses are not hidden object identifiers.
worldBoundary: One-dimensional translation and a movable virtual surface sampler with three view addresses per retinal bin. It is not a geometric 3D renderer or natural fly depth/view control. A view request is an action; the actual view is independently returned and read from the next instrument sample. No hidden object identity, view usefulness, current key, illumination or gain is returned to the controller.
query: While no usable goal-object relation exists, compute prior binary-key Bayes risk minus partition-conditional risk for each reconstructed candidate set and learned view partition. Choose the largest distance-weighted gain, with deterministic address ties. Stop requesting new views when the goal relation is usable. This is a conventional finite-catalog active-sensing calculation, not a novel optimal-control algorithm or calibrated animal belief.
fixedCycleComparator: Visit bin -1/view1, bin +1/view1, bin -1/view2, bin +1/view2 in a fixed cycle only while no usable target relation is available; stop querying on resolution. The separate cut condition disables the query route and is an ablation, not the strong competing model.
controls: same evidence gives same pre-query state/action in differing hidden-key worlds
query route cut and restored without changing learned retrieval
frozen readout versus separately reacquired Ort case
changed goal retains learned view relations
actual rather than issued movement updates relation
every counterfactual expected view remains prediction until acquired
measures: query count and predicted key-risk reduction
actual view change and acquired evidence
query and movement behavior under interventions
retained readout and cross-view knowledge hashes
